cases.label: 全身站立
cases.prompt: Full-body photograph of one adult standing naturally, both arms relaxed at their sides, both hands and both feet visible, neutral studio background.

cases.label: 坐姿
cases.prompt: Full-body photograph of one adult seated on a chair, hands resting separately on their thighs, knees bent naturally, both feet visible on the floor.

cases.label: 握杯
cases.prompt: Waist-up photograph of one adult holding a ceramic mug by its handle with their right hand, left hand resting on a table, both hands clearly visible.

cases.label: 交叉手臂
cases.prompt: Photograph of one adult with arms crossed comfortably across their chest, hands visible, natural shoulders and elbows, frontal view.

cases.label: 行走
cases.prompt: Full-body photograph of one adult walking along a path, one foot forward, opposite arm forward, both hands and feet in frame.

cases.label: 双人握手
cases.prompt: Full-body photograph of two adults facing each other and shaking right hands, their left arms relaxed separately, all four feet visible.

cases.label: 双人拥抱
cases.prompt: Photograph of two adults embracing, three-quarter view, natural overlapping arms and shoulders, waist-up composition.

cases.label: 手部透视
cases.prompt: Photograph of one adult reaching an open right hand toward the camera, palm and fingers visible in perspective, left arm relaxed at their side.

notes: 每个模型使用自己的默认参数，保持场景、尺寸档位和种子列表一致；跨模型相同 seed 不代表相同构图。
模型名和画风不能替代人工评审；动漫用途应单独建立同风格对照组。
未评审、不确定和不适用分别统计，不算合格。
